description: This PHP file defines the SurveyQuestionsDashlet class, which extends DashletGeneric. It sets up a customizable dashboard widget for 'SurveyQuestions' in the SuiteCRM environment, including configuration such as title, search fields, columns, and seed bean initialization.

classes.name: SurveyQuestionsDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying and searching SurveyQuestions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the dashlet with configuration, sets default title if not provided, and initializes search fields, columns, and seed bean.
